text: オーキドの　おじいちゃん　おしごと　たのんだんだって？

structure.jp: オーキドの　おじいちゃん

patterns.name: 〜って (hearsay)
patterns.explanation: って at the end says you heard this from someone else, like 'I hear that...'. たのんだんだって？ = 'I hear he asked you?'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken form of のだ and presents something as the story behind a situation. たのんだんだ = 'it's that he asked'.
